chunks: And Humran narrated from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام:
Regarding the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic,
"Then let them complete their prescribed duties and fulfill their vows."
He عليه السلام said: "Tafath means a man's grooming related to perfume; when he completes his ritual, perfume becomes permissible for him."

key_terms.تَفَثَهُمْ: their state requiring post-ritual grooming after pilgrimage rites
key_terms.حُفُوفُ: grooming or attending to one's bodily condition
key_terms.نُذُورَهُمْ: their vowed acts that must be fulfilled
key_terms.نُسُكَهُ: his ritual act or pilgrimage rite

ai.seo_question: What does «ثُمَّ لْيَقْضُوا تَفَثَهُمْ» mean in Surah Al-Hajj, and when does perfume become permissible for the pilgrim?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the Qur'anic phrase about completing tafath during hajj rites. Imam Abu Ja'far عليه السلام interprets it in connection with a pilgrim's grooming and the permissibility of using perfume after completing the ritual acts.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.2667 - Humran narrated from Abu Ja'far (as) regarding the verse of Allah (swt), the Exalted:
"Then let them complete their prescribed duties and fulfill their vows" (Surah Al-Hajj 22:29).
Imam (as) said: "Tafath refers to a person's grooming, including the use of perfume. Once he has completed his rituals, perfume becomes permissible for him."
